title: Pacing Activity Self-management for Patients With Chronic Fatigue Syndrome
brief_summary: Given the lack of evidence in support of pacing self-management for patients with chronic fatigue syndrome (CFS), it is examined whether physical behavior and health status of patients with CFS improve in response to a pacing self-management program. The effects of pacing will be compared with those observed when applying relaxation therapy to patients with CFS.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* adult
* age range between 18 and 65 years of age
* female gender
* willing to sign informed consent form
* fulfilling the 1994 Centre for Disease Control and Prevention criteria for the diagnosis of chronic fatigue syndrome

Exclusion Criteria:

\- Not fulfilling each of the inclusion criteria listed above.
